name: Sick People
overview: Scripture reveals that God sustains and supports the righteous in their burdens, offering healing and restoration through the Sun of righteousness who arises with healing in His wings. Believers are called to cast their burdens upon the Lord, trusting in His sustaining power and blessing His holy name even amid suffering. The promise that all things work together for good to those who love God assures the faithful that sickness and trials serve a divine purpose within His sovereign plan.
